```python
import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    N = data[0]
    M = data[1]
    MOD = 1000000007  # typical modulus, adjust if needed

    # Precompute binomial coefficients up to N
    choose = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    for n in range(N + 1):
        choose[n][0] = choose[n][n] = 1
        for k in range(1, n):
            choose[n][k] = (choose[n-1][k-1] + choose[n-1][k]) % MOD

    dp1 = [0] * (N + 1)
    dpw = [0] * (N + 1)

    for m in range(1, M + 1):
        for i in range(m):
            w = (dpw[i] * dpw[m - 1 - i]) % MOD
            w = (w * (m + 1)) % MOD
            w = (w * choose[m - 1][i]) % MOD
            dpw[m] = (dpw[m] + w) % MOD

            s1 = (dp1[i] * dpw[m - 1 - i]) % MOD
            s2 = (dp1[m - 1 - i] * dpw[i]) % MOD
            add = ((s1 + s2) % MOD) * (m + 1) % MOD
            add = (add * choose[m - 1][i]) % MOD
            add = (add + w * ((i * (i + 1) + (m - 1 - i) * (m - i)) // 2)) % MOD
            dp1[m] = (dp1[m] + add) % MOD

    dp = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    dps = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    dps[0][0] = 1

    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        dp[i][i] = dp1[i]
        dps[i][i] = dpw[i]
        dps[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i):
            dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j]
            dps[i][j] = dps[i-1][j]
            for k in range(1, j + 1):
                term1 = (dpw[k] * dps[i - k - 1][j - k]) % MOD
                term1 = (term1 * choose[j][k]) % MOD
                dps[i][j] = (dps[i][j] + term1) % MOD

                term2 = (dp[i - k - 1][j - k] * dpw[k]) % MOD
                term3 = (dps[i - k - 1][j - k] * dp1[k]) % MOD
                add = (term2 + term3) % MOD
                add = (add * choose[j][k]) % MOD
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + add) % MOD

    print(dp[N][M] % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
